page.overview:
Who is Fake James Bond?

The Fake James Bond is an unnamed Octopus henchman, who was disguised as James Bond as part of Red Grant's training.

At a country estate owned by Octopus, a man impersonating Bond is put through a highly realistic infiltration scenario, demonstrating combat skills comparable to those of the real agent. Unbeknownst to him, he is being observed by the assassin Red Grant, who ultimately garrottes and kills the impostor. The exercise is then revealed to be a training operation conducted by Octopus, with Grant proving his capability to eliminate high-value targets, including Bond himself.
